title: Agentic Commerce Bench: Measuring Fraud Detection for Agents That Spend Money
abstract: arXiv:2609.35886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents now hold spend authority and settle payments without per-action human confirmation. The resulting loss is often not a security failure: a counterparty with the correct domain, the correct settlement address and a genuinely delivered service can charge more than it should, and no check keyed on identity will see it. We present three artefacts for measuring and reducing that loss. First, a taxonomy of agentic commerce fraud that separates five observation levels (agent reasoning, wire, settlement rail, counterparty, principal) from the request-level and history-level evidence available at each, and records which levels can observe which attacks. Second, Agentic Commerce Bench (ACB), a benchmark of twenty fraud classes generated from production aggregates, 1,647 catalogued service operations and 1,068 settlements, of which six involve a counterparty that is exactly who it claims to be. Third, gordonguard, an open-source detector

translated_title: 代理商务基准：面向会花钱的智能体的欺诈检测测量
translated_abstract: AI智能体现在拥有消费权限，并且无需人工逐项确认即可完成支付结算。由此产生的损失往往并非安全故障：一个拥有正确域名、正确结算地址且确实交付了服务的交易对手，可能会收取超出其应得的费用，而任何基于身份核验的检查都无法察觉这一点。我们提出了三项用于测量和减少这种损失的成果。第一，一个代理商务欺诈分类法，它将五个观察层级（智能体推理、转账、结算通道、交易对手、委托人）与各层级可获得的请求级和历史级证据区分开来，并记录哪些层级可以观察到哪些攻击。第二，代理商务基准（ACB），一个包含二十个欺诈类别的基准测试，这些类别由生产聚合数据、1,647个编目的服务操作和1,068笔结算生成，其中六个类别涉及一个完全符合其声称身份的交易对手。第三，gordonguard，一个开源检测器（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对AI智能体自动支付场景下“身份合法但超额收费”的新型欺诈损失，提出了五层级观察视角的代理商务欺诈分类法、包含二十个欺诈类别的ACB基准测试以及开源检测器gordonguard。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a five-level observation taxonomy for agentic commerce fraud, the Agentic Commerce Bench (ACB) with twenty fraud classes, and an open-source detector gordonguard, to measure and reduce losses from AI agents being overcharged by counterparties that are legitimate in every identity check.
